note: ALA-LC Armenian Romanization Table (2022 version; earlier versions: 2011, 1997) (https://www.loc.gov/catdir/cpso/romanization/armenian.pdf; local source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-armenian.pdf). Rows in document order: the letter table pp. 1-2 line by line (upper then lower per printed line), the Note 3 soft-sign combination table (p. 2), then the letter-numeral table (p. 7) as printed column streams (left column top-down, then right). Primary values only: the bracketed West Armenian alternates are excluded per the map's encoding scope. Skipped un-expressible rows: the Ե/ե Y/y alternates (Note 2: initial position of a name followed by a vowel, Classical) and the Յ/յ Ḥ/ḥ alternates (Note 4: initial position of a word or stem in a compound, Classical) are position-dependent; the composite numerals ԺԱ․ ԺԲ․ ԻԱ․ ԻԲ․ ԼԱ․ ԼԲ․ are multi-letter values and the map encodes single-letter numeral rules only; the ․․․ continuation placeholders are not romanization rows. The punctuation section (pp. 5-6) is instruction prose, not a table: «» and ։ are encoded as map rules but are not row-transcribed here; ՞ and ՜ require sentence-end repositioning and are un-encodable as character rules; ՛ has empty output, which the generator contract (non-empty to) excludes — it is already encoded as a map rule. The diacritics page (p. 4) repeats letter-table rows and adds none. The Ev row's printed lower-case vernacular cell is the ech-yiwn ligature և; եվ is not a printed table row (the map encodes it additionally). The printed rows for Զ/զ and Ս/ս carry a '(see Note 3)' reference marker; transcribed as plain Z/S values. The aspiration mark is U+02BB, the soft sign U+02B9, the numeral leader U+2024; tilded/macroned/dotted Latin letters are the printed precomposed forms.
